item.title: Pope Leo urges war leaders to halt fighting after deadly strike on school sparks outrage
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV called Sunday for an immediate ceasefire in the war involving Iran, urgently urging world leaders to halt violence after deadly strikes hit schools and civilian areas.

item.title: Iran arrests dozens accused of spying for Israel in new internal crackdown
item.summary: Iran says it has arrested dozens of alleged spies linked to Israel across several provinces, accusing them of sharing the locations of military sites and economic infrastructure.

item.title: US could take Iran’s main oil export hub ‘at a time of our choosing,’ Jack Keane says
item.summary: Retired Gen. Jack Keane warns U.S. could seize Iran's critical Kharg Island oil hub "at a time of our choosing," potentially crippling Tehran's economy.

item.title: Lamar Odom reveals Kobe Bryant's mysterious message from beyond in 'vivid' dream encounter
item.summary: Lamar Odom revealed a vivid dream where the late Los Angeles Lakers legend Kobe Bryant delivered a surprising message about the afterlife during their competition together.

item.title: String of attacks connected to naturalized citizens raises national security questions
item.summary: Four alleged terror attacks connected naturalized U.S. citizens in March expose critical security gaps in America, a security expert warned on Fox News.

item.title: FCC chair Brendan Carr warns broadcasters must 'correct course' on 'news distortions' before license renewals
item.summary: FCC chair Brendan Carr warned broadcasters running "fake news" could lose licenses during renewals, citing public interest requirements and media accountability.

item.title: Schiff, Booker deflect on shutdown blame amid terror concerns, thousands of DHS workers without pay
item.summary: Democratic senators Schiff and Booker deflected blame over the DHS shutdown amid terror concerns in the U.S. on Sunday, as workers have gone weeks without pay.

item.title: Oscars 2026 brings star-studded red-carpet fashion led by Heidi Klum and Rose Byrne
item.summary: Oscars red carpet 2026 delivered glamorous fashion as Heidi Klum wore champagne crystal gown, Rose Byrne stunned in black mermaid dress, and Felicity Jones chose pale yellow tulle.

item.title: Illegal immigrant released under Biden charged with groping female students at Virginia high school
item.summary: Mother of three students speaks out about alleged sexual assault case at Virginia high school, criticizing delayed notification and school district policies.

item.title: Rihanna shooting suspect’s disturbing posts emerge as star joins growing celebrity list facing fan threats
item.summary: Unwelcome visitors for celebrities reach a dangerous new level as Rihanna joins a list of stars like Taylor Swift and Ariana Grande facing obsessed fans and attackers.
